newsitem.title: UK: IGC cuts 1997 world wheat crop estimate.
newsitem.headline: IGC cuts 1997 world wheat crop estimate.

text.p: The International Grains Council on Thursday cut its estimate for the 1997 world wheat crop to 583 million tonnes from its previous estimate last month of 585 million.
This compares with estimated 1996 production of 579.5 million.
But in its latest montly report the IGC raised its estimate for China's output to 109 million tonnes from 106 million previously.
The effect on total output was largely offset by a two million tonne cut in estimated Russian production to 34 million tonnes. Estimated U.S. production was cut by 1.5 million tonnes to 61.5 million.

Among other changes, half a million tonnes was cut from estimated Pakistani production, bringing it down to 16.5 million tonnes. Half a million tonnes was also cut from the IGC's estimate of the total African crop, lowering it to 18.3 million tonnes. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
